species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 47°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 12–52 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 85 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 125 ft, so fish stay above it.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
